air_note: Per IQAir 2019 the annual figure was 7.3 (peak July 13.5); 2023 and 2025 were heavy wildfire seasons in Canada (country 2025: 7.4), the 2024 average of 6.0 does not reflect them.
quakes_note: 1944 Cornwall–Massena, M5.8 (intensity VII); 2010 Val-des-Bois, M5.0 (VI); 1732 Montreal M5.8. NBCC 2020: PGA 0.33 g at 2%/50 years; at 10%/50 years (475) not found, the moderate class is an estimate from the ratio of probabilities, not from the figure.
bike_note: The cycling pages did not open; per descriptions a large network of NCC paths and lanes, but almost no cycling in winter, estimate based on descriptions.
walk_note: Rideau Canal, large parks and the centre, but the pedestrian zone is limited and the winter is cold (based on descriptions).
note: PGA for 475 years not found (only 2%/50: 0.33 g); cycling and walking based on descriptions.

air_season: dust episodes from the Sahara/Arabia (more often in spring and autumn), heat in summer; not verified
air_note: IQAir series: 2019 — 19.2, 2022 — 16.4, 2024 — 15.2, 2025 — 13.0; for Cyprus as a whole 11.8; in the annual series Nicosia is more polluted than Limassol (13.0 versus 10.5). Dust from the Sahara and Arabia (more often in spring and autumn) and summer heat; the season is not determined exactly.
quakes_note: Cyprus (Wikipedia, list): 1953 Paphos M6.5 (about 40 dead, ~100 injured, tsunami), 1996 Paphos M6.8 (2 dead, 20 injured), 2022 Paphos M6.6 (minor damage); 1900 Limassol M7.0 as stated was not found in the Wikipedia list - not confirmed. Closer to Nicosia there are no strong earthquakes with damage in the past 100 years in the sources found. PGA: national annex EC8 - 0.20 g (zone 2); range of other estimates 0.20–0.32 g (TEC 2007 / NCSC 2015 - 0.30, UN - 0.32); for the southern coast Cagnan & Tanircan (2010) give 0.3–0.4 g, which does not apply to Nicosia.
bike_note: 61 km of bike lanes in Nicosia (Cyprus Mail, December 2021, per the Ministry of Transport), plus 16 km planned, while connectivity is broken (the ministry promises to 'connect the unconnected lanes'); EasyBike rental is listed as active in the list of systems (launched October 2011), the status of nextbike/Bike in Action is unclear, currency not confirmed; a car-oriented city, heat up to 46 °C. Estimate based on descriptions.
walk_note: Pedestrian Ledra Street (~1 km) and the old town within the walls; in 2023 trees covered only 3% of the city — the least among EU capitals, heat in summer.
note: PGA for Nicosia diverges strongly between sources (0.20 / 0.30 / 0.32 g); the value of the EC8 national annex was taken.
verify_note: IQAir 13.0 confirmed from the ranking row; PGA 0.20 g confirmed by two articles as an EC8 value, but the ETEK zones (0.15/0.20/0.25) differ from those set in the task (0.10/0.15/0.20). Bicycle and dust remain an estimate based on descriptions, 1900 Limassol M7.0 not confirmed.

air_season: dust episodes from the Sahara/Arabia (more often in spring and autumn); not verified
air_note: IQAir series: 2021 — 15.0, 2023 — 14.3, 2024 — 10.0, 2025 — 10.5; in the annual series Limassol is cleaner than Nicosia, although in the current IQAir snapshot at 30.09 it is among the cities with the highest AQI (44). Dust from the Sahara and Arabia (more often in spring and autumn), season not precisely determined.
quakes_note: Cyprus (Wikipedia, list): 1896 Limassol (moderate damage), 1953 Paphos M6.5 (about 40 dead, tsunami), 1996 Paphos M6.8, 1999 Limassol M5.6 (15 injured, buildings damaged, landslides), 2022 Paphos M6.6 (minor damage); 1900 Limassol M7.0 as stated was not found in the Wikipedia list - not confirmed. PGA: normative EC8 (national annex, zone 3) - 0.25 g; scientific model Cagnan & Tanircan (2010) - 0.3–0.4 g on rock on the southern coast; the normative 0.25 g was chosen, range 0.25–0.40 g, class high with possible very_high.
bike_note: 22.5 km of bike lanes in Limassol (Cyprus Mail, December 2021), another 8 km in the near-term plans and 18 km under the sustainable mobility plan; nextbike rental is listed since May 2012 (Wikipedia, list of systems), currency not confirmed. Estimate based on descriptions.
walk_note: Waterfront and old town, marina; the city is car-oriented, hot in summer. Estimate based on descriptions.
note: PGA — midpoint of the published range 0.3–0.4 g (2010 model), the exact value for the city not found.
verify_note: IQAir 10.5 confirmed from the ranking row. PGA changed 0.35 → 0.25 (normative value instead of the midpoint of the model range), class very_high → high; the city's membership in zone 3 on the map was not verified, range 0.25–0.40 g. Bicycle is an estimate based on descriptions.

air_season: winter: heating and inversions (Nov–Feb); in spring dust storms
air_note: IQAir 2025: 26.8 versus 30.9 in 2024, 34.1 in 2023 and 58.8 in 2017; Wikipedia gives 30 µg/m³ for 2022. Winter episodes are still noticeable.
quakes_note: 1679 Sanhe–Pinggu Mw8.0, about 45,500 dead, intensity VIII in Beijing (the White Pagoda and the Desheng Gate were destroyed); 1976 Tangshan M7.6, over 240,000 dead in Tangshan itself, strongly felt in Beijing. The RMS model (2007): a repeat of 1679 would cause about $100 billion in damage.
bike_note: Bike lanes along main roads since 1965, but some were cut back for car traffic, new outskirts have none; in 2018 2.4 million shared bikes; share of bike trips 32% (2005/2011, data outdated), now significantly lower. The terrain is flat.
walk_note: Parks (Beihai, Jingshan, Summer Palace) and hutongs in the centre, but the scale and smog in bad air limit walks.
note: PGA 0.20 g obtained by converting the zoning (Beijing is designed for intensity 8, GB 50011/GB 18306), not a number from a map.

air_season: winter, coal in heating and inversions (Nov–Feb, general knowledge)

note: PGA not found, intensity class 7–8 MSK (EMCA model, 2015 article); converted per Wald 1999 (VII: 0.18–0.34 g, VIII: 0.34–0.65 g), high/very_high boundary.

air_season: winter, heating and transport (Dec–Feb); not checked month by month

air_season: transboundary smoke from Sumatra, August–October (general knowledge, not verified)
quakes_note: No strong local earthquakes; the risk comes from distant subduction zones near Sumatra (control event Mw8.7 at a distance of 550 km); at 2% in 50 years PGA 0.18 g. No damage in the city in 100 years, tremors from Sumatra are occasionally felt (2004 Mw9.1).
bike_note: Share of bicycle trips 0.5% (2018, Wikipedia 'Modal share'); heat and humidity, cycle paths fragmentary, estimate from descriptions.
walk_note: Estimate based on descriptions: heat and humidity, broken pavements; the Lake Gardens and KLCC parks are local.

pm25_src: IQAir World Air Quality Report 2024 (via an Atlas & Boots publication, capitals ranking)

air_season: winter, heating and transport (Nov–Feb); not checked month by month
air_note: The IQAir series is unstable: 2021 — 34.7, 2022 — 22.6, 2023 — 15.7, 2024 — 14.7, 2025 — 16.1; no data for 2020 and earlier.
quakes_note: Vrancea: 1977-03-04 M7.4–7.5 (in the Moldavian SSR 2,765 buildings destroyed and 20,763 severely damaged, 2 dead, panic in Chișinău); 1986-08-30 M7.1–7.2 (officially 2 dead; in Chișinău, according to unconfirmed data, 4 apartment buildings collapsed, more than 12,500 homeless in the Chișinău–Cahul area).

air_season: worse in summer: per IQAir 2019 April–October, peak June (59), best February (18.7); dust and sand episodes more frequent in spring–summer

air_season: almost no seasonality: fires and Saharan dust in summer
air_note: IQAir series: 2025 — 8.1; 2024 — 7.4; 2023 — 7.6; 2022 — 7.5. Cross-check with the CCDR-LVT network (2024) is qualitative only: PM2.5 "muito inferiores" to the limit of 25; no independent figure.
quakes_note: 1755 Lisbon (Mw 8.7–9.0, 50–100 thousand dead, tsunami up to 18 m), 1909 Benavente (Mw 6.0, 60 dead, Santarém area), 1969 Gulf of Cádiz (Mw 7.8, 25 dead, tsunami). PM2.5 not confirmed by an independent figure (only the qualitative conclusion of CCDR-LVT); bike ok confirmed with a caveat (63/90, 2.5%, unsafe intersections).

air_season: winter, heating and transport (Nov–Feb); not checked month by month

air_season: winter, heating (coal, wood), thermal power plants and inversions (Nov–Feb)
air_note: Annual IQAir 2025 — 16.2 (2024 — 17.9; 2020 — 24.3), while the state SEPA stations gave a city average of 23 µg/m³ for 2022. In winter the peaks are much higher: IQAir January 2020 — 67.3, November 2020 — 36.7; on 16 January 2025 in the districts of Resnik, Lazarevac, Barajevo, Banovo Brdo PM2.5 was 55–62 µg/m³ (one-off readings, Vreme/Beoeko); on 14 November 2025 AQI 153, top-10 in the world. Did not find monthly data for winter 2024/25 and 2025/26 or the number of days above 15 (WHO) or 25 (EU) specifically for Belgrade; for Serbia the stations gave on average 104 days above 25 µg/m³ in 2025 (RERI), and Serbia has no daily PM2.5 standard. The SEPA category for 2024 is «III, excessively polluted air» (PM10 and PM2.5, NO2, arsenic, benzo(a)pyrene). Correction: 19.1 at Airly is the average for all of Serbia for 2024, not for Belgrade (Belgrade there is 17.9).
quakes_note: There are no destructive earthquakes in Belgrade itself over ~100 years in the Wikipedia list; the nearest notable events — 1927 Kragujevac M6.0, 1980 Raška M5.8, 2010 Kraljevo M5.5 (2 dead), 1991 Timiș (Romania) M5.6 with light damage in Belgrade. According to the national hazard map (seismo.gov.rs, 475 years, ground A) Belgrade is in the range ~0.10–0.14 g, pga=0.12 — the middle of the range, read from the map automatically (not a numeric table); class moderate.
bike_note: Fewer than 1% of residents ride a bicycle (2018), at that time 120 km of new lanes and a 5% target were planned; a city-wide bike rental was only planned in 2019 (150 stations, 900 bicycles; N1, August 2019, tender). Found no more recent confirmation of a launch (Wikipedia on transport in Belgrade does not mention bicycles), estimate based on descriptions.
walk_note: Pedestrian Knez Mihailova, Kalemegdan, Ada Ciganlija, Sava and Danube embankments; in winter smog spoils walks.
note: Belgrade: the annual average of 16.2 (2025) hides winter peaks; Did not find monthly winter data for 2024–2025, the most recent monthly ones are 2020.
verify_note: IQAir 16.2 confirmed from the ranking row (with a check of neighbouring rows); the second source is only SEPA-2022 (23 µg/m3), other years. Monthly winter 2024/25 data and the number of exceedance days for Belgrade could not be found (IQAir pages without history, SEPA/NEA/RERI reports without a Belgrade breakdown), pga 0.12 was read from the map automatically and requires visual verification.

air_season: transboundary smoke from Indonesia, August–October (in 2019 — 19.0)

Dipova & Cangir (2017) take into account deep subduction events up to Mw 6.5 and crustal faults up to Mw 6.6. December 2013: a series of 16 events M3.6–5.8 in the Gulf of Antalya (thrusts, depth 40–45 km). Strong events nearby: 24–25 April 1957 Fethiye — two shocks M7.1 and M7.3 between Rhodes and Fethiye (19–67 dead according to different sources, ~90% of buildings in Fethiye damaged); 1926 Rhodes ~M7.7 (per the iisee catalogue ~110 dead, mainly on Rhodes; Found no information on damage in Antalya).
